claim: QA round 24 (2026-11-07), item 2, gateway half: the Gmail push, force-fetch and house-inbox publishers send the receiving server's own verdict (the topmost Authentication-Results whose authserv-id is exactly mx.google.com, never the last-wins header map) as ingress_authentication_results, and RabbitMqBridgeService.handleInboundEmail, once the vendor is matched, holds a letter whose verdict says dmarc=fail, or an aligned spf=fail with no aligned dkim=pass, with held_reason 'sender_unconfirmed' instead of filing it under the vendor. No verdict decides nothing (the Postmark webhook sends none today). The Python half is separate; MAIL-ATTRIBUTION-IGNORES-AUTHENTICATION flips, with a rewritten verify, when the second half merges.
